entries.title: John 16:1
segments: ¶These things I have spoken unto you that ye may not be offended.

entries.title: John 16:2
segments: They shall put you out of the synagogues; but the hour is coming that every one who kills you will think to render service to God;

entries.title: John 16:3
segments: and these things they will do because they have not known the Father nor me.

entries.title: John 16:4
segments: But I have spoken these things to you, that when their hour shall have come, ye may remember them, that I have said [them] unto you. But I did not say these things unto you from [the] beginning, because I was with you.

entries.title: John 16:5
segments: But now I go to him that has sent me, and none of you demands of me, Where goest thou?

entries.title: John 16:6
segments: But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.

entries.title: John 16:7
segments: ¶But I say the truth to you, It is profitable for you that I go away; for if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I go I will send him to you.

entries.title: John 16:8
segments: And having come, he will bring demonstration to the world, of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

entries.title: John 16:9
segments: of sin, because they do not believe on me;

entries.title: John 16:10
segments: of righteousness, because I go away to [my] Father, and ye behold me no longer;

entries.title: John 16:11
segments: of judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.

entries.title: John 16:12
segments: I have yet many things to say to you, but ye cannot bear them now.

entries.title: John 16:13
segments: But when *he* is come, the Spirit of truth, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but whatsoever he shall hear he shall speak; and he will announce to you what is coming.

entries.title: John 16:14
segments: He shall glorify me, for he shall receive of mine and shall announce [it] to you.

entries.title: John 16:15
segments: All things that the Father has are mine; on account of this I have said that he receives of mine and shall announce [it] to you.

entries.title: John 16:16
segments: ¶A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me, [because I go away to the Father].

entries.title: John 16:17
segments: [Some] of his disciples therefore said to one another, What is this he says to us, A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me, and, Because I go away to the Father?

entries.title: John 16:18
segments: They said therefore, What is this which he says [of] the little while? We do not know [of] what he speaks.

entries.title: John 16:19
segments: Jesus knew therefore that they desired to demand of him, and said to them, Do ye inquire of this among yourselves that I said, A little while and ye do not behold me; and again a little while and ye shall see me?

entries.title: John 16:20
segments: Verily, verily, I say to you, that ye shall weep and lament, ye, but the world shall rejoice; and ye will be grieved, but your grief shall be turned to joy.

entries.title: John 16:21
segments: A woman, when she gives birth to a child, has grief because her hour has come; but when the child is born, she no longer remembers the trouble, on account of the joy that a man has been born into the world.

entries.title: John 16:22
segments: And ye now therefore have grief; but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one takes from you.

entries.title: John 16:23
segments: ¶And in that day ye shall demand nothing of me: verily, verily, I say to you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

entries.title: John 16:24
segments: Hitherto ye have asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

entries.title: John 16:25
segments: These things I have spoken to you in allegories; the hour is coming that I will no longer speak to you in allegories, but will declare to you openly concerning the Father.

entries.title: John 16:26
segments: In that day ye shall ask in my name; and I say not to you that I will demand of the Father for you,

entries.title: John 16:27
segments: for the Father himself has affection for you, because ye have had affection for me, and have believed that I came out from God.

entries.title: John 16:28
segments: ¶I came out from the Father and have come into the world; again, I leave the world and go to the Father.

entries.title: John 16:29
segments: His disciples say to him, Lo, now thou speakest openly and utterest no allegory.

entries.title: John 16:30
segments: Now we know that thou knowest all things, and hast not need that any one should demand of thee. By this we believe that thou art come from God.

entries.title: John 16:31
segments: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

entries.title: John 16:32
segments: Behold, [the] hour is coming, and has come, that ye shall be scattered, each to his own, and shall leave me alone; and [yet] I am not alone, for the Father is with me.

entries.title: John 16:33
segments: These things have I spoken to you that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye have tribulation; but be of good courage: I have overcome the world.
